centre: CRISPR P1: product-dependent observability, observed-sequence correspondence and target-relative finite-record inference. Other genomic/acoustic hypotheses remain separate.
timing: Retrospective expansion; MP05 CFTR outcomes known. External literature summaries visible, but no external raw records or detailed human annotation files opened yet. Not blinded, public preregistered or prospective biological validation.

gates.question: Disentangle orientation, competing references and gap incentive in the 89 suffix discordances
gates.scope: 45 new engine jobs, same nine CFTR streams; five predefined partial-factorial profiles; compare with frozen forward M/P and MP05 PE default.

gates.question: Replace one traceback with the complete set of locally admissible coding projections among all optimal paths in the declared zero-incentive affine objective
gates.scope: Actual previously discordant CFTR records and deterministic hash-selected real-record comparators; exact optimal-path DAG, path counts, coding interval sets, whole-string and event invariance; compare unmodified engine tracebacks and enumerate actual small path sets for independent checking.

gates.question: Transport operational checks beyond CFTR using an accession-linked external prime-editing experiment and published human interpretation
gates.scope: Start SRR10285861 HEK3 Fig2b_10_rep2 from Anzalone2019 PRJNA565979, used as human PE benchmark by CRISPR-A2023. Authenticate source sequence, metadata, raw identifiers and rater granularity before interpreting agreement. Add source-compatible controls/replicates by metadata rather than selecting desired outcomes.

gates.question: Compile task-relative certificates and decision consequences rather than equating every useful event claim with whole-string equality
gates.scope: Native local and exact programmed CFTR predicates; preserve required-profile U as wildcard. Whole-string, event-label and joint-target certificate levels remain distinct. External task has its own source-authenticated predicate.

gates.question: Integrate actual outcomes, adverses and frontier gates in a successor article/supplement
gates.scope: Private LaTeX MP06; public source and scientific outputs remain subordinate. No full article/supplement publication before author bioRxiv deposit.

stop_rules: Source identity mismatch stops affected use
Unmapped human interpretation is not record-level or molecular ground truth
A finite profile union is not all possible alignments
All-optimal proof is restricted to the explicit scoring objective; no universal biological accuracy claim
If an optimal path lacks required coding flanks, its unknown projection cannot be silently discarded
No external human reproduction is claimed from project-run code or CI
Do not introduce synthetic biological records or simulations
